nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: An open yard. A court is painted on the concrete, with a climbing frame, a bench and a small shed beside it. The gate you came through is behind you.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is nobody around. Nobody here to tell you where to stand, either.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You reached the open yard behind the estate: a court two hoops wide, a shed, a bench, a climbing frame.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is a gap in the fence behind the shed. The ground on the other side is the same concrete as this side.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The equipment shed has a green door with a hasp and a padlock hanging from it. A sheet is taped inside the window, facing out.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You could try the door, or have a look at the sheet in the window. Or leave it alone.

choices.text: Try the door against its frame.
Read the sheet in the window.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Hold on. Look at the gap between the door and its frame.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The door has not warped. There is a gap by the hinges, about the same width from top to bottom. Whatever used to fill it seems to have been taken out.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The shed door swings in: the padlock is shut around empty air and the hasp is held by nothing.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Chairs are stacked almost to the ceiling. Beside them are a coil of rope and three broken shuttlecocks. A strip of tape is stuck under the seat of the top chair, with a name written on it. Nobody sitting there would see it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You cannot make out the name from the doorway. You would have to move the chairs, and the stack is too high to shift safely.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The frame does not look crooked. You cannot see what is wrong with it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The door will not move. There is light under it, but the paint behind the hasp is clean, as if the hasp used to be fixed somewhere else.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The shed door does not close flush. The paint behind the hasp is clean and the hasp is screwed in crooked.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Look at the sheet in the window. Pay attention to where it has been stuck.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Nine rows. The edges line up neatly with the window frame. The last two rows list the same day, but the second one is dated a week later.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The duty sheet in the shed window lists the same day twice; the second copy is dated next week.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: A duty rota on the window. Lines down the sides, blank space in the middle.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You count again. There are only eight rows. Rain has blurred two of them together. One surname is still readable, the same one chalked on the wall at the alley entrance.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The duty sheet has been rained on. One surname on it is also chalked on the alley wall.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You leave the padlock alone. Looking back, you see that the nearer hoop has no net. The one at the far end does.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A table-tennis ball is wedged between the shed's concrete footing and the ground. Something pale and flat shows beneath the hedge behind it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The gap goes deeper than the ball.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Put your hand in and feel around. I'll help you work out how far it goes.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: A hand's depth in, you touch concrete, then an edge. There is a small ledge behind the ball, with something on it. It is not round.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Behind the ball, on a ledge under the shed, there is a flat metal tag with a hole in one end.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The tag is cold and blank on one side. On the other side there is a stamped number, four digits, and the paint in the digits is the same green as the shed door.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: There is nothing behind it. A hand's depth in, and then the gap ends.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You scrape your knuckles. The ball shifts, then wedges itself back in place. The pale thing under the hedge is not behind the ball; it is further out, like a streak of white paint on a stick.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The ball stays wedged. The shed has two footings and the gap is only on one side.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Try the shadow first. Better than scraping your knuckles.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The shadow reaches further than the gap. The thing under the hedge is closer to you, and it is not shaped like a ball.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The pale thing under the hedge sits nearer than the wedged ball, so it is not the ball's shadow.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: One gap, one ball, one shadow. It all seems to line up.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The numbers add up, but that does not tell you anything. The ball is still stuck. The shed has two footings, and only the left one has a gap. Somehow you noticed that just after getting the sum wrong.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The sums balanced and told you nothing. The shed has two footings and the gap is only on the left one.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You leave the ball where it is. It is not yours, and nobody is waiting here to collect it.
